newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up amid retail buying.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up amid retail buying.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed higher on Tuesday with retail investors buying on positive market sentiment, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index gained 51.51 points or 2.93 percent at 1,806.20 on a turnover of 95.8 million taka. Of 119 traded issues 93 gained and 22 lost.

"Market sentiment is very positive as the good scrips reached reasonable levels after a temporary withdrawal of price fluctuation limit for 43 issues," one broker said. IDLC leasing company gained 148 taka to 4,925, BOC Bangladesh rose 7.0 to 238 and Beximco Pharmaceuticals was up 6.0 to 198.
